verdict.rationale: Segment provides a Privacy Portal, consent management, and general privacy/compliance tooling (GDPR/CCPA/HIPAA references) plus a Tracking Plan/Spec for data governance, but the evidence does not document per-destination controls like field-level hashing, masking, or selective filtering of sensitive attributes before data reaches specific destinations. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-destination PII transformation rules (hashing/masking configuration), field-level filtering UI or API, and independent/hands-on confirmation that these controls work as described.
